mod_rof_single_counted.expression: (() => { const weapon = { name: 'X', type: 'Sturmgewehr', autoMods: false, mods: { magazine: { type: 'rof', val: 20 } } }; const modRof = modAttrTotal(weapon, 'rof') || 0; return weaponEffectiveRpm(weapon, Math.max(0, 20 - modRof)).rofPct; })()

mod_rof_effective_rpm.expression: (() => { const weapon = { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'Sturmgewehr', autoMods: false, mods: { magazine: { type: 'rof', val: 10 } } }; const modRof = modAttrTotal(weapon, 'rof') || 0; return weaponEffectiveRpm(weapon, Math.max(0, 10 - modRof)).rpm; })()

sustain_factor_eagle_bearer.expression: weaponSustainFactor({ name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'Sturmgewehr', autoMods: false }, 850)
sustain_factor_eagle_bearer.note: Modded Mag 60 @850 RPM (4,235s Feuerzeit), Empty Reload 2,11s -> 4,235/(4,235+2,11) = 0,6675

effective_mag_stats_eagle_bearer.expression: effectiveMagStats({ name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'Sturmgewehr', autoMods: false }).mag
effective_mag_stats_eagle_bearer.note: Modded Mag Size wird vor Base Mag Size verwendet

magazine_average_optimist_fallback.note: Optimist Ø ohne DB-Daten: max 35% / 2 = 17,5% WD

auto_mods_no_chc_at_cap.expression: (() => { const m = computeAutoMods({ name: 'X', type: 'Sturmgewehr', autoMods: true, core2Type: 'chc', core2Val: 60, minorType: 'chd', minorVal: 15 }); return Object.values(m).some(x => x.type === 'chc') ? 1 : 0; })()
auto_mods_no_chc_at_cap.note: Bei gedeckeltem CHC darf kein CHC-Mod mehr gewählt werden (Fix #32)

magazine_average_measured_eagle_bearer.expression: magazineAverageTalent('abgemessen', { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'AR', autoMods: false }).wd
magazine_average_measured_eagle_bearer.note: Issue #34: Abgemessen als Magazin-Ø (60 Schuss: obere Hälfte -25% WD / untere +30% WD) statt Best-Case +30%

magazine_average_measured_rof_eagle_bear.expression: magazineAverageTalent('abgemessen', { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'AR', autoMods: false }).rof

magazine_average_frenzy_eagle_bearer.expression: magazineAverageTalent('raserei', { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'AR', autoMods: false }).wd
magazine_average_frenzy_eagle_bearer.note: Raserei Ø: floor(60/10)=6 Stacks à 3% = 18% WD (Issue #34: je 10 Kugeln statt 8, wie kuratierte Talent-DB)

magazine_average_optimist_eagle_bearer.expression: magazineAverageTalent('optimist', { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'AR', autoMods: false }).wd
magazine_average_optimist_eagle_bearer.note: Optimist Ø unverändert: +3,5% je 10% fehlender Munition über 60 Schuss

magazine_average_strained_eagle_bearer.expression: magazineAverageTalent('angespannt', { name: 'Eagle Bearer', type: 'AR', autoMods: false }).chd
magazine_average_strained_eagle_bearer.note: Angespannt Ø unverändert: +10% CHD je 0,5s, max 5 Stacks, 60 Schuss @ 850 RPM
